topic: Large Language Models and the Transformer Architecture
target_audience: University students with a basic background in computer science

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Vector Space Concept
lecture_lines: Words are converted into numerical vectors.
animations: Fade in a grid labeled 'Vector Space' in #FFFFFF color.
Highlight a single vector 'v' in #FF00FF color.
Animate 'v' adding to another vector 'u' to form 'v+u' in #00FFFF color.

sections.title: The Transformer Core: Self-Attention Mechanism
animations: Display the self-attention formula in #FFFFFF color.
Flash Query (Q), Key (K), and Value (V) matrices in #FFD700.
Animate the dot product QK^T heatmap in #FF0000.

sections.title: Scaling Up: From Transformer to LLM
animations: Show multiple Transformer blocks stacked in #FFFFFF color.
Pulse a layer to illustrate expanding model depth in #00FF00.
Animate weights updating across the layers in #FF4500.

sections.title: Application: The Probabilistic Prediction Engine
animations: Display a probability distribution over vocabulary in #FFFFFF.
Animate picking a token from the tail of distribution in #FFFF00.
Transition to the next generated word in #800080 color.
